title: Presence Detection Accuracy
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=homeassistant:event entity_id="person.*"
| transaction entity_id startswith="state=home" endswith="state=not_home" maxspan=1d
| stats count as transitions, avg(duration) as avg_home_s by entity_id
| eval flaps_flag=if(transitions>20,"flapping","ok")
description: Measures how often your home/away presence state flips, catching the flapping that makes presence-based automations unreliable.
value: Flapping presence turns the heating and lights on and off all day; detecting it lets you tune the device trackers behind it.
implementation: Forward person-entity state changes; schedule daily and investigate entities that flap excessively.
visualization: Table of people by presence transitions per day.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether your home reliably knows when you are in or out, so the lights and heating behave correctly.
